title: ArcCivs .96 existing iron tool demand chain
assumptions: Explicit sensitivity, not runtime telemetry: 5/20/60 existing native craft completions per active blacksmith-day. One cycle stays60seconds before hunger slowdown, walking, stock and courier delays. No timers grant production without observed completion.

Pickaxe row represents one alternative tool recipe, not four simultaneous outputs. Shovel1Iron+2Sticks, Axe/Pickaxe3Iron+2Sticks, Hoe2Iron+2Sticks each produce1, exactly existing native catalog. No rates, resource quantities or prices change.

The new connection automates existing consumer hut demand, then existing courier delivery and arrival-gated equip. One spare per assigned resident/hut remains the existing desired-stock policy. Accepted recipe version and durable inventory receipts fence replay/duplicate pickup.

Item input/output rows are separate units; no coin redemption assumed. Current SELL and future contracts remain separate unchanged. Auto remains closed IRON_TOOL_KIT and does not materialize native tools or player withdrawals.

flows.source: CivsProduction.inputs + native60second production interval; CivsCarpentry demand allocator
flows.basis: Same existing pickaxe recipe before/after; alternative manual selected production vs automatic per-building one-spare demand. Production time alone ceiling60cycles/hour excludes required walking, supplies, food and full stores.
